maal.eng: understand and follow rules for hiking and wear the proper clothing according to the weather and outdoor conditions

maal.eng: explore and play games, take part in sports activities, dancing and other movement activities

maal.eng: use one's body to explore activities and develop basic movements

maal.eng: practise and use basic skills, such as running with, throwing, bouncing, kicking and catching a ball in various movement activities

maal.eng: understand how one’s own body and others’ bodies are different, and include others in different movement activities

maal.nob: utforske uteaktiviteter og samarbeide med andre under vekslende årstider i nærmiljøet
maal.eng: explore outdoor activities and cooperate with others during the different seasons in the local environment

maal.eng: make and use maps to orient oneself in familiar terrain

maal.nob: øve på trygg og sporløs ferdsel i naturen
maal.eng: practise safe and sustainable nature wandering

maal.nob: forstå og følge regler i trafikken
maal.eng: understand and follow traffic rules

maal.eng: explore, play and play games, and play together with others in various movement activities

maal.nob: øve på sammensatte bevegelser, alene og sammen med andre
maal.eng: practise complex movements, alone and together with others

maal.eng: take part in activities according to one’s own interests and abilities in dancing, outdoor life, sports activities and other movement activities

maal.nob: bruke kart, digitale verktøy og tegn i naturen til å orientere seg i natur og nærmiljø
maal.eng: use maps, digital tools and signs in nature to orient oneself in nature and the local environment

maal.eng: understand and follow the rules for activities and games and respect the results

maal.eng: perform basic techniques in front stoke swimming, backstroke swimming and swimming under water

maal.eng: assess the safety of outdoor activities and nature wandering and learn self-rescue in water

maal.eng: use the local environment and explore local outdoor life cultures

maal.eng: explain the public right of access in nature and behaviour in nature

maal.nob: gjennomføre overnattingstur og reflektere over egne naturopplevelser
maal.eng: go on overnight trips and reflect on one’s own experiences of nature

maal.eng: explore one’s own opportunities for exercising, health and well-being through play, dancing, outdoor life, sports activities and other movement activities

maal.eng: exercise and develop skills in a variety of movement activities

maal.eng: practise and carry out dance activities from youth cultures and other cultures, and together with co-pupils create and present dance compositions

maal.eng: reflect on how different presentations of the body in media and society affect movement activity, and how the pupil sees his or her body and self-image

maal.nob: planlegge og gjennomføre bevegelsesaktiviteter som kan gjennomføres ved skader eller sykdom

maal.eng: use one’s own skills and knowledge in a way that might help others to have progress

maal.eng: recognise differences between oneself and others in movement activities and include everyone, regardless background and abilities

maal.eng: understand and perform lifesaving in, on and by water out in nature

maal.nob: vurdere risiko og sikkerhet ved ulike uteaktiviteter, og forstå og gjennomføre sporløs og trygg ferdsel
maal.eng: assess the risk and safety of a variety of outdoor activities, understand and carry out sustainable and safe nature wandering

maal.nob: beskrive egne styrker og egenskaper og interesser, og kunne se dette i sammenheng med utdannings- og yrkesønsker og livsmestring
maal.eng: describe their own strengths, qualities and interests, and consider them in relation to their desired education, career and life skills

maal.nob: samle, analysere og bruke informasjon om utdanning og arbeid
maal.eng: gather, analyse and use information about education and employment

maal.nob: utforske utdanningsmuligheter på varierte måter, og gjøre rede for ulike utdanningsveier og hvilke yrkesområder de kan føre til
maal.eng: explore career opportunities in various ways, and describe different educational pathways and careers they may lead to

maal.nob: tilegne seg kunnskap om arbeidslivet gjennom utprøving og utforskning og reflektere over hvordan bærekraftsmål, konjunkturer og teknologi påvirker arbeidsmarked, yrker og arbeidsmåter
maal.eng: gain knowledge of the workplace by testing, exploring and reflecting on how sustainability goals, conjunctures and technology impact the labour market, occupations and working methods

maal.eng: see the opportunities and transform their own ideas into taking action and making decisions, and reflect with others on the consequences of career choices

maal.nob: utvikle og bruke mestringsstrategier for å håndtere overganger og utfordringer relatert til utdanning og karriere
maal.eng: develop and use coping strategies to handle transitions and challenges related to education and careers

bruke flere programmeringsspråk, deriblant minst ett som er tekstbasert
bruke grunnleggende prinsipper i programmering, slik som variabler, løkker, vilkår og funksjoner, og reflektere over bruken av disse
analysere problemer, gjøre dem om til delproblemer og gjøre rede for hvordan noen av delproblemene kan løses med programmering
planlegge og skape et digitalt produkt og vurdere dette med tanke på brukervennlighet
utvikle og feilsøke dataprogram som løser definerte problemer, inkludert kontrollering eller simulering av fysiske objekter
